column2: [6] Power Struggle

While the Mobile Infantry has been occupied with driving the Bugs out of caves and mining tunnels, the Arachnids have broken into the main hydro-electric power plant in the sector.

To restore power and prevent long-term damage to the Kwalashan industry and civilian infrastructure, liberating the facility is now the primary objective.

Bugs are holed up tight inside the power station.  Gonna be a real nightmare to pry them outta there.
Point taken, Colonel, but your mission is to root out the bug infestation and secure vital machinery around the facility.
Initial priorities are the damaged power turbines.  They'll have to be repaired by your combat engineers - but getting to them won't be easy.
There are three possible insertion points for your force: The Northwest, in front of the main entrance...
... to the east, at the end of the dam...
... or to the south, by the storage tanks. The team on the ground has to make the call on how to proceed.
Command is asking for a progress report.
We've just got one turbine up and running.  Moving to the next one now
You might have to pick up the pace.  Brass is feeling the pressure.
OK OK, we'll step on it.
The tech heads here report enough turbines are operational.  Good job.
OK, we'll start the battle from here.  Get some Engineers out to those turbines.  We need them up and running.
The center of the power plant is secure!
The core temperature has reached critical levels! Meltdown is imminent!

Heat signatures from the center of the station indicate the power core is starting to overheat. It must have been damaged when the bugs breached the facility. You have to reach it before the reactor goes into meltdown!
Intel reports a large scale bug infestation in the center of the power station. You'll need to muster a strong force to clean that up.
Intel shows a security building here. If you recapture it, we can gain access to the facility's security cameras.
It would be useful to know what we're sticking our noses into
Security center's ours.  I've got cameras are coming online now
Intelligence calculates that the Bug forces have been sufficiently weakened.  You're instructed to concentrate on the remaining mission objectives.
The bugs are getting pretty pissed. We have to take out those bug caves and cut down their numbers.
Understood. Command is allocating extra resources to your strike force.
These big Tiger bugs sure are tough bastards.  We're gonna need some heavier firepower to punch through.
Request's been granted.  Troopers armed with Morita IIs are dropping now.
Get an ammo dump set up to support deployment of these squads.
Great work. Station is back up and running and power's being restored as we speak. Instructions are to leave any Bug stragglers to the follow up crews.
That's the best news I've heard all day. I'm going to get me a hot shower and a cold beer - not necessarily in that order
Shit, this operation is a complete Charlie Foxtrot. Mission failed.
Construct turrets in the center to suppress the bug tunnels!
Command didn't give us enough troops to keep the whole sector secured. Use gun turrets to support both defensive and offensive operations.
